crates.name: deep-vector
crates.what: one vec! literal of 135,000 untyped integers: type inference and integer fallback over a huge expression (rustc-perf deep-vector)

crates.name: trivial-consts
crates.what: 6,000 libc-style const items with literal values plus a few const fn, size_of and const-block constants: const lowering and evaluation

crates.name: trait-heavy
crates.what: type-level Peano arithmetic ~150 deep, an inferred-index HList and a Diesel-shaped query builder with blanket impls, projections and 16-ary tuple impls: trait solving and normalization

crates.name: deep-macro
crates.what: macro_rules recursion 1,500 deep, a quadratic tt-muncher over 800 tokens and one 12,000-pair invocation: macro expansion and large token streams

crates.name: big-file
crates.what: one 1.4 MB file of 18,000 small items: parsing, spans and hashing; edits.json holds a line inserted at the top to shift every span
